Based on my exploration of qlang and the data files, here are the queries for each task:

J1: /data | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(coalesce ~(/address/city) ~(false) | ne false) * /name | sort ~(lower)

J2: | filter ~(coalesce ~(/status | lower) ~("") | eq "paid") * /items | flat * (mul /qty /price) | sum | round 2

J3: [/dependencies /devDependencies] | reduce {} ~(union) | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys * keyword | sort

J4: | filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(coalesce ~(/assignee/login) ~("unassigned")) * count

J5: /services | filter ~(coalesce ~(/enabled) ~(true) | eq true) * {:name /name :timeout (coalesce ~(/timeout) ~(30)) :retries (coalesce ~(/retries) ~(3))} | sort ~(/name)

J6: | filter ~(coalesce ~(/durationMs) ~(false) | ne false) | groupBy ~/service * (apply ~(* /durationMs | sum | div (count) | round 1))

J7: | filter ~(coalesce ~(/stock) ~(0) | gt 0) | sort ~(/price) | reverse | take 3 * /name

J8: | groupBy ~/dept * (apply ~(coalesce ~/skills ~([]) | flat * lower | distinct | sort))

J9: | every ~(if (/role | lower | eq "db") ~(/region | eq "eu-west") ~(true))

J10: "Alice@Example.com, bob@test.org; carol@EXAMPLE.com, dave@mail.net; erin@Test.org, frank@example.com" | split ~(^[,;]\s*) | * (split ~(@) | last | lower) | distinct | sort

J11: apply ~(lines | * apply ~(split " " | if (gte (at 3) 500) ~({:path (at 2) :count 1}) ~(false)) | filter ~(ne false) | groupBy ~/path * count | sort ~(/value) | reverse | take 2 | * {:path /key :count /value})

J12: apply ~(lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") | * apply ~(split "," | {:name (at 0) :team (at 1) :score (at 2 | parse)}) | filter ~(/score | ne "") | groupBy ~/team * (apply ~(* /score | sum | div (count) | round 2)))

J13: apply ~(lines | filter ~(ne "") | filter ~(startsWith "#" | every) | * apply ~(split "==" | {:name (at 0 | lower) :version (at 1)}) | reduce {} ~(union))

J14: | sort ~((coalesce ~/comments ~([]) | * (coalesce ~/likes ~(0)) | sum)) | reverse | first | /title
